Tool-Board Layout — three 48"×48" plywood panels + electrical outlets (scaled elevation)
Every 1/4" corner bolt lands between studs, clearing the nearest stud by ≥ 2.5" center-to-center. Two outlets sit fully behind Panels A & C (green dashed = plate footprint, hidden behind panel).

6" reveal above counter. Outlet 1 center is 10.25" above the countertop, Outlet 2 is 10.5"; offsets shown are measured from each affected panel's bottom-left corner. Origin 0 = left end of countertop.
Left: a taller countertop (+4.25" step) with a 3" backsplash (top 7.25" above lower counter) runs off the left edge and overlaps Panel A's lower-left corner (red). Panel placement not yet revised.
Scale: 6 px = 1 inch. openGrid layout intentionally unchanged where it overlaps an outlet (handled in board design/printing).
